verdict.rationale: OpenHands Cloud advertises 'hosted cloud access from desktop and mobile' which implies some mobile access to running agent sessions, but there is no evidence of a specific approval/confirmation workflow for key agent decisions (e.g., pausing for human sign-off) that a PM could use from a phone; the only related control mentioned is CLI 'auto-approve all actions', which is the opposite of manual oversight. Missing for 10: documented approval/confirmation UI, mobile-specific interaction for pausing/resuming agent actions, and any PM-oriented oversight workflow beyond generic 'desktop and mobile' access.
